g.title:
7. Bank Head Office (Victoria Island / Marina, Lagos) [Corporate Operations Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The executive administrative headquarters housing the Treasury Dealing Room, Executive Boardroom, 24/7 SOC & NOC Command Center, Central Operations Reconciliation Desk (EOD/NACS/NIP), and corporate HR/IT facilities.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Directs executive bank strategy, executes multi-million dollar money market and FX trades, monitors network health across all 14 telcos, manages cybersecurity threats, and balances daily interbank general ledgers.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Bloomberg B-PIPE & Refinitiv FIFX Market Feeds via Leased Circuits (Ports 8194 & 443), CyberSOC Africa & SIEM Telemetry via TLS (Port 6514), Internal Branch WAN traffic via Core Layer-3 Switches • OUTBOUND: Primary DC Calypso & Finacle Treasury via High-Speed LAN, Cloud Databricks & Power BI via Direct Connect (HTTPS 443), Non Self-Hosted SaaS via Forcepoint SWG (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Quadruple redundant fiber feeds (MainOne, IPNX, Broadbased, 21st Century), dual building substations, N+1 diesel generator sets, and redundant core routing chassis. • SECURITY: Biometric access control, dedicated Treasury Dealing voice/screen recording, physical separation of trading floors, and 24/7 SOC perimeter defense. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 7. BANK HEAD OFFICE (VICTORIA ISLAND / MARINA, LAGOS)
HEAD OFFICE

g.title:
Treasury Dealing Room & Capital Markets Desk [Section 7: Bank Head Office] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: High-security institutional trading floor equipped with Bloomberg Professional terminals, Refinitiv (FIFX) trade analytics, and Calypso Treasury systems.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Executes interbank foreign exchange (FX) spot and forward transactions, sovereign bond auctions, money market placements, and liquidity management.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Bloomberg London DC via Point-to-Point Leased Circuit (Port 8194), Refinitiv POP via Financial Leased Line (Ports 443/14002) • OUTBOUND: Primary DC Calypso & Finacle Treasury via High-Speed Internal LAN, CBN Extranet S4 System for mandatory foreign exchange reporting • FAILOVER: Diverse dual-routed leased lines from different telecom providers; automated trader desk failover to secondary DR dealing room. • SECURITY: Dedicated physical access control, continuous voice and screen transaction recording, and strict separation of Front, Middle, and Back Office duties. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Treasury Dealing Room & Capital Markets Desk
Institutional FX, Money Markets & Fixed Income Trading Operations:
• Bloomberg Professional Terminals: Dual-screen trader desks with real-time B-PIPE feed
• Refinitiv (Reuters FIFX): Interbank benchmark pricing, FX matching & market analytics
• Dedicated point-to-point leased circuits to Bloomberg London DC and Refinitiv POP
• Real-time STP trade booking into Calypso & Finacle Treasury
BLOOMBERG & REFINITIV
Executive Suite & Boardroom Governance
C-Suite, Managing Director & Board of Directors:
• Diligent BoardEffect Portal: Encrypted digital board papers, voting, and resolutions
• Executive Power BI & Databricks KPI Dashboards: Real-time deposit, liquidity & P&L
• Microsoft 365 Enterprise Teams & Exchange Online with MFA hardware tokens
DILIGENT BOARDEFFECT

g.title:
24/7 SOC & NOC Command Center [Section 7: Bank Head Office] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Central Security Operations Center (SOC) and Network Operations Center (NOC) command wall operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Monitors enterprise cyber threats, reviews QualysGuard vulnerabilities, inspects Prisma Cloud alerts, correlates SIEM logs with CyberSOC Africa, and oversees link health across all 14 telecom carriers.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Syslog-ng & NetFlow telemetry from all Firewalls, Cloud CCE, Core Banking, and Branches via TLS (Port 6514), CyberSOC Africa MDR portal • OUTBOUND: Automated firewall quarantine rules, incident ticketing in Jira/ServiceNow, and executive crisis notifications • FAILOVER: Hot-standby NOC console at Secondary DR DC; cloud-accessible SOC monitoring portal. • SECURITY: Biometric mantrap access, isolated management VLAN, and continuous threat intelligence ingestion. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
